verdict.rationale: incident.io has Workflows automations (docs-9), and its changelog mentions a Terraform provider for infra-as-code (docs-1), so teams could version, review, and roll back config through git. But the evidence doesn't confirm that Workflows are covered by the provider, and nothing shows native versioning, review, or rollback in the product. missing for 10: native workflow version history, review/approval of automation changes, one-click rollback, explicit Terraform coverage of Workflows, independent corroboration.
